answer: Arrival-Order Relic Window. New agent identities must present a signed relic of prior traffic, and registrations are accepted only when their inter-arrival gaps match the sable distribution of organic joiners. Bursts get queued at a jetty delay proportional to burst width, so a farm pays wall-clock latency per identity plus forfeited queue priority. Masquerading as organic traffic costs sustained real-time pacing across many separate windows.
